## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck` pass (and `pytest python/tests` if Python changed)
- [ ] Verification changes land in all three verifiers, with a test vector
- [ ] Wire changes update SPEC.md and its "Changes" section
- [ ] No personal data or real keys in tests, vectors or examples
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
